about: The Node.js the stage copies into the app (bundle.mjs checkNode) and every job of the release workflow runs: this exact version, the official build (the Node.js project’s own download, signed by the project), its bin/node checked against the sha256 of its platform — the release workflow installs it with actions/setup-node, each job hashes it in the shell before its first node call (darwin-arm64 on the macOS jobs, linux-x64 on the ubuntu ones) and the build refuses any other binary. Upgrading: download each platform’s official tarball from the Node.js project, check it against SHASUMS256.txt and that file’s signature by a releaser the project lists, record the version here (and in .github/workflows/release.yml) with `shasum -a 256 <extracted>/bin/node` for each platform.
